capability.description: A deny-by-default grant of a specific API/data/orchestration right (ENT-22), optionally TTL'd. An operation is covered iff its (domain, action) match exactly and the capability has not expired.

action.description: The specific right within the domain (e.g. 'query', 'read', 'deploy', 'start_run'). The action taxonomy is open in V1.

domain.description: The governance domain of the right.

expires_at.description: Optional TTL: the ISO-8601 UTC instant (same fixed-width format as `created`) at/after which the capability is expired. Omitted means it never expires.

resource.description: A single node-owned object a grant names. The coarse tiers are databases/projects; the fine-grained object tiers (#747) are table/column/blob/tool, which add the optional `database` (table/column) and `columns` (column) fields.

columns.description: The granted column set, for the column kind.

database.description: The owning database, for the table/column kinds.

name.description: The object's handle: database/project name, table name (table/column), blob id-or-prefix, or MCP tool name.

scope.description: What the key permits — deny-by-default. A resource is in scope iff `unrestricted` is true or it appears in `grants`.

grants.description: The explicit in-scope resources. Order is preserved.

unrestricted.description: The '*' grant: when true the key reaches every resource (an admin key) and `grants` need not enumerate them.

description: An access key (ENT-21): the login credential whose scope is the V1 key-scoped access model (RULE-3 / PERM-1 / ADR-6) and whose capabilities are the deny-by-default rights model (ENT-22). The on-disk key.json projection of the replicated `key:<uuid>` CRDT value, owned by a principal. Mirrored by zetta::AccessKey in include/zetta/access_key.hpp, zetta::Scope in include/zetta/scope.hpp, and zetta::CapabilitySet in include/zetta/capability.hpp; enforced by scope_from_json()/capability_set_from_json() and Principal::load() in src/core/principal.cpp — keep them in sync. A malformed scope or capability is rejected at the boundary so access never silently widens or narrows.

capabilities.description: The deny-by-default rights this key may exercise (ENT-22) — the verb/right axis, orthogonal to scope's resource axis. Optional; absent means no rights granted. An operation is permitted only by a matching, unexpired capability.

created.description: ISO-8601 UTC creation stamp (millisecond precision, trailing 'Z').

id.description: The key's UUID — its CRDT key and on-disk folder name. Present in key.json (where the folder name is the source of truth) and omitted from the CRDT value (the key carries it).

principal.description: The id of the Principal this key authenticates as.
